title: /clear
body: Starts a new chat and archives the current one. The cheapest habit there is: use it between unrelated tasks.

title: /compact
body: Summarises the conversation to free context and stays in the same chat. Add a focus so the summary keeps what matters, e.g. /compact keep the schema decisions.

title: /fork
body: Copies the conversation into a new session so you can try another approach without losing this one. It copies all history, so it is not a way to save tokens.

title: /plan
body: Hands the task to the Plan agent, which researches and proposes a plan before any code changes.

title: /explain
body: Explains the selected or referenced code.

title: /fix
body: Suggests a fix for problems in the selected code.

title: /tests
body: Generates tests for the selected code.

title: /doc
body: Writes documentation comments, from editor inline chat.

title: /init
body: Generates or updates workspace instructions for the repo. A good first step in a new project.

title: /models
body: Opens the model picker.

title: /tools
body: Chooses which tools a local chat may use. Fewer tools means fewer surprises and less tool output in context.

title: /create-prompt, /create-instructions, /create-agent
body: Describe what you want and Copilot writes the prompt file, instructions file or custom agent for you.

title: /<prompt-name>
body: Runs a prompt file or skill by its name.

title: /new
body: Scaffolds a new workspace or file.

title: /help
body: Lists the commands and agents available.

title: # file, folder or symbol
body: Type # and pick a file, folder or symbol to attach exactly that. Better than pasting, and better than a whole-repo search when you know where to look.

title: #selection
body: Attaches the current editor selection.

title: #problems
body: Adds the errors and warnings from the Problems panel. Use it instead of pasting compiler output.

title: #terminalLastCommand
body: Adds the last terminal command and its output. Use it instead of pasting logs.

title: #terminalSelection
body: Adds only the lines you selected in the terminal. Even leaner than the whole last command.

title: #changes
body: Adds your uncommitted source control changes. Handy for reviews and commit messages.

title: #usages
body: Finds references, implementations and definitions of a symbol.

title: #codebase
body: Searches the whole project and adds what it finds. Powerful but token-hungry: use it when you don’t know where the code lives.

title: #fetch
body: Pulls a web page into the chat. Whole pages are large, so fetch the one page you need.

title: #githubRepo
body: Searches a GitHub repository; give it owner/repo.

title: @vscode
body: Questions about VS Code features and settings.

title: @terminal
body: Shell and terminal questions.

title: @github
body: Repositories, issues and pull requests on GitHub.

title: @workspace
body: Older guides use @workspace for whole-project questions. Current docs use #codebase and the agent’s search tools instead.

title: Open the Chat view
body: Opens the Chat view.

title: New chat
body: Starts a fresh chat in the Chat view, with the Chat view focused. Same effect as /clear.

title: Inline chat (editor or terminal)
body: Chat right at the cursor or selection. Small context, quick answers.

title: Quick Chat
body: A lightweight, temporary chat box for one-off questions.

title: Accept inline suggestion
body: Accepts the grey ghost text. Tab also jumps to and accepts a next edit suggestion.

title: Accept the next word only
body: Takes the suggestion one word at a time, so you keep what you want.

title: Dismiss inline suggestion
body: Dismisses the suggestion.

title: Cycle inline suggestions
body: Older docs give ⌥] / Alt+] to see the next suggestion. Not in the current docs: hover the suggestion to use its toolbar instead.

title: Context window control
body: In the chat input. Hover for tokens used, a breakdown by category and AI credits for the session. Select it and choose Compact Conversation to compact by hand.

title: Automatic compaction
body: On by default: VS Code summarises the chat when the window fills. Leave it on, but don’t rely on it; compact or restart earlier with a focus of your choosing.

title: Auto model selection
body: Routes each request to a suitable model and saves costly reasoning models for hard problems. Paid plans get a small discount when using Auto.

title: Sessions list
body: At the top of the Chat view. Reopen an old chat instead of re-explaining it in a new one.

title: Show memory files
body: Ask the agent to remember something, then inspect what it stored with this command.
